ITEM.PTXT: A semi-center mounted integrated air conditioning unit with a thin RS evaporator (RS: Revolutionary Super Slim) and heater core arranged at the front and rear of the unit is used to reduce size. In addition, ventilation resistance inside the unit is reduced and foot space on the front passenger side is ensured.
A "partial recirculation system" that recirculates part of the cabin air in fresh air mode is used to improve heating performance.
A sub-cool condenser and a thin RS evaporator are used to reduce the amount of refrigerant used, giving consideration to the environment.
A wide-angle high-flow defroster, in which the inner wall of the front defroster is shaped radially, is used for excellent defroster performance.
Rear heater ducts are used on cold area specification models to improve comfort for rear seat occupants.
A pollen filter with improved pollen removal efficiency is used as the clean air filter and is provided as standard on all models.

The blower motor and blower motor controller are integrated to save space, and size and weight are reduced by using a deep-drawn yoke for thinner walls, high-magnetic-force magnets for smaller magnets, and ball bearings in the bearing section for a shorter shaft.

Servo motors for switching the fresh/recirculation damper, the mode damper and the driver side air mix damper have been adopted on all models. In addition, a servo motor for switching the front passenger side air mix damper has been adopted on models w/ dual mode automatic air conditioner. Each servo motor is a pulse pattern type that detects position by pulse signals. With the adoption of pulse pattern type servo motors, a smart connector with a built-in IC having functions such as communication with the air conditioner computer is used.

The servo motors for the mode damper and the driver side air mix damper are installed on the right side of the heater & cooler unit, the servo motor for the front passenger side air mix damper on the left side of the heater & cooler unit, and the servo motor for the fresh/recirculation damper on the right side of the blower unit.

Whereas the conventional type detects position by potentiometer voltage, the pulse pattern type servo motor detects relative position by 2-bit ON/OFF signals. The air conditioner computer counts the number of pulses (patterns) to determine the stop position.

Smart connectors, intended to reduce weight and wiring, have been adopted to drive the pulse pattern type servo motors for air conditioner control. The smart connector contains an IC that combines communication with the air conditioner computer, servo motor drive and position detection functions.

The RS evaporator consists of tanks, tubes and cooling fins; the tubes are extruded to form fine flow passages, providing excellent heat transfer performance and a thinner width (38mm). In addition, the RS evaporator achieves a significant reduction in size and weight by promoting heat transfer through reduced fin height, tube thickness and fin pitch, and by using thinner core materials. The evaporator body has a clean coat that suppresses the growth of bacteria that cause unpleasant odors, and the surface treatment is chrome-free, giving consideration to the environment.

PARA.TITLE: SFA-II Heater Core (SFA-II: Straight Flow Aluminum)

ITEM.PTXT: Compared with the SFA heater core, the SFA-II heater core has a finer core and improved tank and fluid passage shapes, achieving further compactness and higher performance.
The use of aluminum as the material suppresses lead emissions, giving consideration to the environment.
A clean air filter (pollen removal type) consisting of a coarse dust removal layer and an electret layer has been adopted on all models.

The clean air filter (pollen removal type) achieves reduced pressure loss and high removal efficiency through an optimal fiber configuration and a cleanable construction. By removing fine dust such as pollen and diesel particulates, it provides a more comfortable cabin space.
The filter is located above the blower fan in the blower unit, so the clean air filter can be replaced without tools simply by removing a one-touch clip, providing excellent serviceability.
Electret: A substance that semi-permanently produces an electric field in its surroundings.
Always set the recirculation mode and turn the IG OFF before replacing the filter.
To maintain the dust collecting capacity of the filter, replace it periodically.

To maintain the dust collecting capacity of the filter, clean it periodically (every 15000km) and replace it (every 30000km). In addition, in areas with heavy traffic such as large cities or dusty areas such as cold regions, the service life of the filter will be shorter and earlier cleaning (every 7500km) and replacement (every 15000km) may be necessary.
The inner wall of the front defroster is shaped radially to smooth the airflow, providing excellent defroster performance.
